subject: Mobile Development
title: App Store Featuring
description: A quick win: understand App Store Featuring.

hook.text: Getting featured on the App Store front page can make a small developer's career.

buildup.text: Apple's editorial team hand-picks apps to feature based on quality, design, and timing.

discovery.text: A featured spot can increase downloads by 10x or more in a single week.

twist.text: There's no application process. Developers can't buy a featured spot. Apple chooses.

climax.text: Featuring gives Apple tastemaker power over which apps succeed and which stay invisible.

punchline.text: One editor's choice can mint a million downloads.

quiz.question: How does an app get featured on the App Store?
